module: Disk save and reload of the photo mode post-processing effects state (depth of field, motion blur, specular occlusion, SSAO/SSR/reflections/mirrors quality, occupant visibility). The file is used to restore the player's original settings after a photo session. The values read are normalized (booleans, numbers, strings) and unknown fields are ignored.
notes: File written: settings/photomodePostFxRestoreState.json, in the format {version = 1, effects = {...}}. An old file without an envelope (direct effects table) is also accepted on read.

Boolean fields: dofEnabled, dofAutofocus, specularOcclusionEnabled, screenSpaceShadowsEnabled, motionBlurEnabled, occupantsVisible. Numeric fields: dofMaxBlurNear, dofMaxBlurFar, dofFocusRange, dofAperture, dofFalloffSharpness, motionBlurStrength. String fields: ssaoQualityMode, ssrQualityMode, reflectionQualityMode, mirrorsQualityMode.
If a DOF field (dofEnabled, dofMaxBlurNear, dofMaxBlurFar, dofFocusRange) is present but dofAutofocus is not, dofAutofocus is forced to false.
Booleans accept true/false, 1/0, "1"/"0", "true"/"false"; any other value gives false.

RESTORE_STATE_FILE.desc: Relative path of the save file: "settings/photomodePostFxRestoreState.json".

saveRestoreState.desc: Normalizes the effects table then writes it to RESTORE_STATE_FILE. Returns nil, false if the table is not valid or contains no known field.

effectsState.desc: Effects table (fields listed in the notes); unknown fields are ignored.

returns.desc: Normalized state, or nil if there is nothing to save.
true if the file write succeeded (an error is logged otherwise).

loadRestoreState.desc: Reads the save file and returns the normalized effects state, or nil if the file is missing, unreadable or has no known field.
